worked_solution:

Question 9
?

Which statement is equivalent to P∨(¬Q∧¬R)?

a
(P∨¬Q)∨(P∨¬R)
b
(P∧¬Q)∨(P∧¬R)
c
(P∧¬Q)∧(P∧¬R)
d
P∧(¬R∨¬Q)
e
(P∨¬Q)∧(P∨¬R)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

We distribute the disjunction over the conjunction, as follows:

P∨(¬Q∧¬R)≡(P∨¬Q)∧(P∨¬R)
